findings.what: Two figure panels are pushed up onto the body text above them. The nitration scheme's top rule is drawn straight through the line 'significant amount of meta derivative is also formed.', striking out its descenders, and the same rule cuts across the NH2 label of the aniline reactant beneath it. The acetylation/nitration scheme below does the same to the word 'product.' at the end of its introductory paragraph, the NHCOCH3 label of acetanilide sitting beside it. The book leaves clear space between each paragraph and the figure that follows.
findings.where: top rule of the nitration figure (upper third) and of the acetanilide nitration figure (middle)

findings.what: All three reaction schemes are drawn at roughly 35-40 per cent of the book's linear size. The isomer percentages '(51%) (47%) (2%)' and the captions 'Acetanilide', 'p-Nitroacetanilide', 'p-Nitroaniline', 'Anilinium hydrogensulphate', 'Sulphanilic acid' and 'Zwitter ion' are set far below caption size as a result.
findings.where: the nitration, acetylation-nitration and sulphonation schemes

note: Compared text block by block and enlarged all three schemes to inspect them. Nothing is missing. The nitration scheme shows all four structures (aniline plus the para, meta and ortho nitro products) with their NO2 groups in the right ring positions and all three percentages. The acetylation route shows all four stages with (CH3CO)2O/Pyridine, HNO3 H2SO4 288K and OH-/H+ over their arrows. The sulphonation scheme shows aniline with its lone-pair dots, anilinium hydrogensulphate with + on N and - on HSO4, sulphanilic acid, the equilibrium arrows and the zwitter ion with + on NH3 and - on SO3. Both subsection labels '(b) Nitration' and '(c) Sulphonation' and the closing Friedel-Crafts paragraph are present, and the folio '273 Amines' prints its number once in the yellow box. The figures' small size makes the charge signs and lone-pair dots fine, but they survive enlargement, so I report the scale as formatting rather than as lost content.
